race.comment: HELLS REIN (14) just missed the frame here when resuming and will have derived some benefit from that hit-out. Gets the reliable Vandyke/Wiggins combination and should be right there at the business end. RUBICK'S SHADOW (6) has placed two of his past three and gets a bunch of weight off with the 3kg claim. Finds the right race and is worth including for value. DUN DARTE CHEAP (2) strips fitter third-up from the spell and may earn some minor money. SILENT ANSWER (13) returned from a layoff last start and was beaten 6 lengths into tenth over 1400m at Gold Coast. Better for the run and can feature here.
